title: profile
description: A profile's public profile record, at the path `profile`: one per profile. A profile lives in one market, in one role; its label is <market>/<role>. The fields below are the standard's; any other field is the market's (foundationforest/markets).

market.description: The market this profile lives in, as the markets directory spells it: the first half of its label.

role.description: Its role in that market, the second half of its label: any text. Which roles exist, and which count, is the market's and each index's.

pay.description: Optional. The profile's payment addresses, one for each address type: keys/'s payAddresses(seed, label). Where payments to this profile go. A reader ignores a type it does not know.

solana.description: Its address on Solana: base58 of an ed25519 public key.

evm.description: Its address on EVM chains: 20 bytes in hex after 0x, in EIP-55's mixed-case checksum, its one spelling (keys/'s isEvmAddress checks it).

inboxKey.description: Optional. The profile's inbox key, as an age post-quantum hybrid key (`age1pq1…`, mlkem768x25519, 1,959 characters): what senders seal messages to, and others seal private records to. Without it, nobody can seal anything to this profile.

proofs.description: Optional. Proofs the profile shows, each one data anyone checks with its circuit's verifier (proofs/), for this profile's key.

inbox.description: Optional. The profile's inbox: who may deliver a message to it on its hosts. Senders seal each message to inboxKey, so a profile with an inbox also gives inboxKey. Without this field there is no inbox, and hosts refuse deliveries. A host refuses deliveries to an inbox it cannot read: a field, a rule or a value it does not know.

senders.description: Who may deliver: anyone, or a profile whose profile record carries a note proof from this issuer, under any label.

issuer.description: The issuer's key: its address, a packed point on Baby Jubjub in base58.

once.description: Optional. One message from each sender, ever: a host refuses a second from the same key for as long as it keeps the profile.

maxBytes.description: Optional. The largest message it takes, as canonical text in bytes. A host also takes messages only up to its own size.

proof.description: One proof, named by its circuit. A reader ignores a proof whose circuit it does not know, so a profile carrying a newer kind stays valid for an older app. A note proof and a reputation proof have the shapes below; another circuit's fields are its own.

circuit.description: The circuit that checks it: note (proofs/note/) and reputation (proofs/reputation/) have the shapes below.

note.description: A note proof (proofs/note/): the issuer with this key and this name signed a note for the person whose seed gives this profile's key for this label, and this is their tag for the label at that issuer. Everything verifyNote takes but the profile's key, which is the profile's own address.

issuer.description: The issuer's key: its address, a packed point on Baby Jubjub in base58.

issuerName.description: The name the issuer publishes as its own, exactly as keys/'s recipe takes it: the proof's name hash is made from it.

label.description: The profile's label, exactly as the seed's mix took it: the proof's scope is made from it.

tag.description: The person's tag for the label at the issuer: 32 bytes big-endian, lowercase hex.

proof.description: The proof's three points, uncompressed: 256 bytes in base64url without padding, in the reputation proof's order.

reputation.description: A reputation proof (proofs/reputation/): the count-weighted score of profiles in an index's tree that come from the same seed as this one, which profiles hidden. It holds only for this profile's key, which the proof derives from that seed. What the score means is what the index says its root holds. Everything verifyReputation takes but the profile's key, which is the profile's own address.

index.description: The index's signing key: its address, a packed point on Baby Jubjub in base58.

root.description: The root of the index's tree the proof was made against: the 32 big-endian bytes the index signed, lowercase hex.

time.description: The time the index signed with the root, ms since 1970.

signature.description: The index's signature over the root and the time, as proofs/reputation/ defines its signed bytes: EdDSA-Poseidon on Baby Jubjub, 64 bytes (R8 packed, then S) in base64url without padding.

score.description: The score the proof shows: the count-weighted score of the profiles counted, rounded down.

label.description: Present only when the proof shows one market: the label of the one profile counted, exactly as the seed's mix took it.

proof.description: The proof's three points, uncompressed: 256 bytes in base64url without padding. Eight numbers of 32 bytes big-endian, in snarkjs's names pi_a[0], pi_a[1], pi_b[0][1], pi_b[0][0], pi_b[1][1], pi_b[1][0], pi_c[0], pi_c[1]: the order Ethereum's and Solana's BN254 precompiles read.
